notes:
SafeStore now handles a backup drive that fills up or goes missing mid-wedding.

- If your backup drive fills up or goes missing, you can move the wedding to another drive or copy the cards onto a new one, and SafeStore keeps track of which drive holds what
- An empty transfer no longer gets stuck on a drive that's full or missing
- Adding a second SD card while uploads are running no longer leaves stray files in Dropbox
- Clearer messages when a drive, card or Dropbox step needs you
- No change to how footage is copied or verified
